title: Updating sortBy causes RefinementList to forgets showMore state
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

When updating a RefinmentList `sortBy` value after it has been expanded, it "forgets" its showMore state, and returns to showing the amount of refinements specified in `limit` and not `showMoreLimit` if it has been expanded

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

1. Go to the repro
2. Click "show more" and view 20 options
3. Click "sort by name"
4. Watch as it "collapses" to 5 options

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/s/nervous-shtern-pt3vk8

### 💭 Expected behavior

The RefinmentList should stay expanded when `sortBy` is updated

### Package version

react-instantsearch-hooks-web@6.44.0
